attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is the one Western entry of this day that saint.gr does not mark**: seven of the day's other entries carry the asterisk and the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου, ή τα βιογραφικά στοιχεία του ή η ημερομηνία εορτής του», and they are refused; this page carries neither, and it cites the Apostoliki Diakonia of the Church of Greece under it, so it is drafted. **He is not `honoratus-of-arles`**, whom the corpus already keeps: that is the founder of Lérins and bishop of Arles, this the bishop of Amiens born at Port-le-Grand nearby, and the two sees are named on the page. **No `dates` object**: the page gives no year and no century at all. **No hymn, no relics, no parents, no manner of death beyond falling asleep in peace.**
